summary_en: Three painter-style portraits (Egyptian mural, Van Gogh impasto, Monet impressionism) of a stylised Carl, rendered with the huashu-art-motion painting library in Node and canvas.
limits_en: In the Egyptian version Carl wears a white linen kilt; only the T-shirt, hairstyle, glasses and smile are kept.
In the Monet version the brush-stroke density on Carl is lower than in the background; the tree-shadow light spots are kept faint so they do not read as dirt.
